verdict.rationale: Team chat inside a work-planning tool is a fair axis for Jira, but the evidence never documents an in-product chat or messaging feature. The only related evidence covers syncing with external tools like Slack and Trello, which is an integration with another product rather than chat inside Jira, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can chat with my team directly inside the same tool I plan work in
